owner_instruction: Apply the LIQ source usefulness, fallback and rate-budget discipline to every active report block. Search for additional free sources when current sources do not provide strong useful coverage, and connect them only after exact-asset factual validation and report-consumer proof. Maximize useful information per source and block, remove sources from a block when they add no useful information, and reuse already verified earlier block audits unless a new defect or changed source/data requires rechecking.

scope.also_includes: core selection, shared market collectors and manual/Telegram consumers wherever the source contributes

per_block_required_evidence: approved exact asset and applicable spot/futures market
provider source clock, response status, numeric useful fact and identity
upstream-independence grouping; same primary venue is one source
actual consumer and manual/Telegram rendering, not catalog availability
historical saved evidence first, bounded fresh probe only for missing fact
fallback on unusable/stale/rate-limited response with explicit no-data outcome
source calls per 40-minute full cycle, each manual reserve and same-day overlap with other blocks
monthly/daily/minute provider and shared HTTP/D1 limits, source-specific 429 and temporary free entitlement
natural full-cycle and same-run Telegram proof before declaring stable
implementation_order: Finish LIQ natural full report and provider/Telegram verification; then apply the common accounting and fallback mechanism across every active block in large related packages, with one combined check after each package. Do not resume paused blocks.
current_state: REQUIREMENT_RECORDED; LIQ EIGHT-HTTP PATH CLOUD-ASSEMBLED BUT NATURAL FULL CYCLE OPEN; CROSS-BLOCK IMPLEMENTATION NOT YET VERIFIED
prohibited_claims: all 105 assets have useful data in every block
rate-safe forever based solely on a static budget
source connected merely because it returned HTTP 200
strategy_constraints: Existing score weights, threshold, approved report and Telegram forms remain unchanged unless the owner separately agrees.
source_efficiency_measurements: exact approved assets with current usable facts per source and block
useful source-backed facts reaching consumer and rendered output per admitted provider HTTP
source freshness, schema, HTTP failures and 429 outcomes
independent primary venue overlap, avoiding duplicate upstream counting
incremental coverage and quality beyond existing sources for the same block
daily and monthly quota headroom after all shared block usage
block_local_exclusion_rule: Remove a source only from a block where it is proven unhelpful. Never disable a shared source for other active blocks solely because one block does not use it.
prior_proof_reuse: Reuse exact prior head/hash/artifact of already checked blocks; repeat source probes or tests only for a new defect, changed upstream behavior or missing fact.
